# 立体纸雕概念海报 cover prompt

You are a top-tier cover art director, editorial visual designer, typography designer, and image-generation prompt director.

Create one single WeChat Service Account article cover, aspect ratio 2.35:1, target 1410×600, single final image. Use case: polished Chinese editorial cover. Language: Chinese.

## Input and content understanding

- Title/topic: AI到底是什么
- A-layer main visual title: AI到底是什么
- B-layer complete title: AI到底是什么
- C-layer subtitle: 从生成到行动
- Short context: 用 10 个概念解释 AI 如何生成内容、接收信息并借助工具执行任务，同时提醒读者它会产生幻觉，不能把流畅回答当成事实。
- Audience: 想系统理解 AI、但不想先学复杂技术的普通读者。
- Mood: 理性、克制、清晰、带一点探索感。
- Visual metaphor: 一条纸雕路径从“输入窗口”穿过层叠的概率空间，最终从“行动出口”伸向现实；同一条连续路径表达生成、接收、行动三个阶段。
- Banned elements: 人形机器人、机械脑、赛博霓虹、芯片俗套、复杂流程图、密集小字、虚构品牌、错误中文。

Only use the derived ideas above. Do not copy article paragraphs. First glance must read the topic; second glance must understand that AI is a process connecting input, generation, and action rather than magic.

## Style application and composition

Use physically believable layered cut paper: visible paper thickness, precise apertures, subtle fibers, folds, slight curled edges, and soft contact shadows. This must look like a real paper sculpture photographed in one studio light, not flat illustration with a paper filter.

Build one wide focal construction across the center: on the left, a clean cut-paper input window; through the middle, layered concentric paper corridors suggesting probabilistic generation; on the right, one small opening and a single paper path continuing outward to imply action. Keep this as exactly one metaphor and one focal point. Use generous premium negative space above and below.

Integrate the exact title “AI到底是什么” into the paper construction. The letters are cut from, embedded in, and partially interleaved with the layers while remaining fully readable and correctly written. Make “AI” slightly larger, and keep the Chinese phrase intact on the same visual path. Place the short subtitle “从生成到行动” once, small and restrained, as a debossed paper label. No other text.

Palette: warm off-white and pale cool gray paper, muted indigo-blue inner layers, one tiny orange paper edge at the action exit. Matte tactile surfaces, coherent depth, soft diffused light, natural fine shadows, no hard black shadow.

Reading path: title first, then the paper corridor from left to right, then the subtitle. The cover must be legible as a small social-feed thumbnail.

Avoid childish craft, decorative paper borders, multiple competing subjects, dense information, plastic, foam, metal, cheap CGI, loud gradients, PPT/course-cover layout, advertisement feel, misspellings, gibberish, detached typography, crop marks, mockups, contact sheets, or alternatives.

Generate only one final image.

# kimi风格 cover prompt

You are a top-tier cover art director, editorial still-life photographer, typography designer, and image-generation prompt director.

Create one single WeChat Service Account article cover, aspect ratio 2.35:1, target 1410×600, single final image. Use case: Chinese editorial explainer cover. Language: Chinese.

## Input and content understanding

- Title/topic: AI到底是什么
- A-layer main visual title: AI到底是什么
- B-layer complete title: AI到底是什么
- C-layer subtitle: 10个概念，看懂AI
- Short context: 文章用 LLM、Token、思考强度、幻觉、Prompt、Context、RAG、Tool、Skill、Agent 十个概念，讲清 AI 从生成内容到接收信息，再到执行任务的完整链路。
- Audience: AI 初学者与想建立系统认知的职场读者。
- Mood: 冷静、可信、好奇、研究档案感。
- Visual subject: 少量真实研究物件构成“语言模型如何连接输入与行动”的俯视档案桌。
- Visual metaphor: 一枚半透明玻璃棱镜接收左侧的文字 Token 小块，经中心的三段轨道，把一个实体小工具推向右侧，表现输入、生成、行动。
- Banned elements: Kimi Logo、任何真实品牌 Logo、产品界面、纸张堆、文件堆、人物、机器人、复杂 UI、霓虹科技风、乱码。

## Style application and composition

Use top-down archival still-life photography on a large pale gray-green light-table. Soft diffused light, realistic contact shadows, true scale, clean surface, low saturation, and generous negative space. This is a photographed working research table, not illustration, 3D render, or floating product stage.

Arrange one coherent horizontal object system with few objects only: at left, four small ivory ceramic tiles carrying abstract dot-and-line marks that suggest tokens but contain no readable text; at center, one clear glass prism over three slim parallel metal rails; at right, one precise stainless-steel drafting tool or compact mechanical gripper touching a small cobalt-blue block. The spatial relationship must clearly read as information entering, being transformed, and becoming action. Every object serves the topic; do not fill the table.

Reserve a pristine title zone in the center-left negative space. Render the exact title “AI到底是什么” once in sharp, modern Chinese editorial typography, large, dark charcoal, completely accurate and unobstructed. Add the subtitle “10个概念，看懂AI” once beneath it in smaller neutral sans serif. No additional labels, fake archive numbers, or decorative English.

Palette: pale mint-gray tabletop, ivory ceramic, clear glass, brushed aluminum, warm wood accent, charcoal type, one restrained cobalt-blue object. Materials must show real glass transparency, brushed metal, ceramic matte texture, and natural micro-scratches without dirtiness.

Reading path: title, then token tiles → prism/rails → tool block, then subtitle. Preserve wide breathing room and social-thumbnail legibility.

Avoid copied official layouts, Kimi marks, fixed archive templates, meaningless decoration, excessive papers, clutter, neon, cyberpunk, cheap futurism, complex UI, glow, blurred title, wrong Chinese, dense microtype, advertisement feel, PPT/course cover, grid, contact sheet, or multiple options.

Generate only one final image.

# 初始提示词

# 超大标题图文穿插 cover prompt

You are a top-tier cover art director, editorial visual designer, typography designer, and image-generation prompt director.

Create one single WeChat Service Account article cover, aspect ratio 2.35:1, target 1410×600, single final image. Use case: high-impact Chinese editorial article cover. Language: Chinese.

## Input and content understanding

- Title/topic: AI到底是什么
- A-layer main visual title: AI到底是什么
- B-layer complete title: AI到底是什么
- C-layer subtitle: 生成 · 接收 · 行动
- Short context: 文章通过 10 个基础概念拆解 AI，说明它如何生成回答、使用当次上下文与外部资料，并通过工具、技能和智能体把回答变成行动。
- Audience: 对 AI 好奇的普通用户与职场读者。
- Mood: 现代、理性、直接、有探索张力。
- Visual subject: 一个单一、高识别度的“开口黑盒”装置，左侧吸入文字碎片，右侧伸出一只真实但无人物身份的工作手套夹持工具；装置整体轮廓清楚。
- Visual metaphor: AI 不是人形大脑，而是一个把输入转成输出并可连接行动的系统。
- Banned elements: 机器人、机械头、铬面人像、雕塑头像、未来假人、复杂面板、多主体、错字、乱码。

## Style application and composition

Use one central subject only: a matte-black rectangular “black box” with an open slit, photographed or rendered as a believable physical editorial object. From the left edge, a restrained stream of small white token tiles enters; from the right, one simple gloved hand/tool extension emerges, creating a strong clean silhouette. The subject occupies the central band but leaves obvious breathing room.

The exact title “AI到底是什么” is enormous, bold, geometric sans serif, and spans most of the landscape canvas. Create explicit depth layers inside the same title: some strokes sit behind the black box, the box occludes parts of them; other strokes cross in front of the box. Show at least two visible front/back order switches within the title, with both “subject over type” and “type over subject” in the core overlap zone. All seven Chinese characters and “AI” must remain legible, accurate, and recognizable; do not hide critical strokes.

版本对应：课 1 的图文穿插风格选用用户指定的 cover-v2，逐图提示词同时保存初始生成内容与清理文字的修订指令。课 2 同时保留初版和 cover-v2；用户反馈为“【AI工具选择指南】右边的图案既看不懂，也不好看”，修订版改为工具卡与任务凹槽的纸雕匹配装置。

风格观察（整理笔记）：课 1 探索纸雕层次、档案静物、标题穿插、连接隐喻与黑白极简等不同表达；课 2～5 以奶油白纸质、灰蓝层次、深蓝标题和单一视觉隐喻建立系列感。可对照“统一材质与字体层级”和“按主题改变视觉隐喻”的做法。

提示词：保留两段原始需求、第二轮反馈，以及本地结果目录中找到的 12 份原始生成与修订提示词。每张图旁可以展开查看和复制，原始文件另有打包下载。

技能包：由用户提供，保存本次提供的完整技能文件与参考素材。原包未附独立的作者或许可声明。

范围：仅收录指定图片、提示词和技能文件，不收录课程文章正文。图片原文件完整保留，未裁切或重新生成。
